function DataHelper:RerollDailyQuest(player:Player,classes:string)
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)

    local los:{DailyQuestsSetting.Type} = ConfigHelper:Get(DailyQuestsSetting,DailyQuestsSetting.k.classes,classes,true)
    local oldDailyQuestVo = playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords[classes]
    for i=1,20 do
        -- 最多随机20次确保不重复，避免极端情况一直随机到相同任务导致死循环
        local randomLo = los[math.random(1,#los)]
        if oldDailyQuestVo and randomLo.id == oldDailyQuestVo.questId then continue end

        -- 随即成功
        local newDailyQuestVo:CommonType.DailyQuestVo = {
            questId = randomLo.id,
            progress = 0,
            awarded = false,
        }
        playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords[classes] = newDailyQuestVo
        break
    end
    DataHelper:FireChanged(player)
    return playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords[classes]
end

function getKey(tableStr,all)
	if not all then
		all = false
	end
	return tableStr.."_"..tostring(all)
end

function ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)	
	local suc = false
	local vo = nil
	local rw = rawget(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey) or nil
	if rw then
		suc = true
		if typeof(rw) ~= "table" then
			vo = nil
		else
			vo = ConfigVo.cacheMap[mapKey]
		end
	end
	
	return suc,vo
end
